_comment: PRE-LAUNCH SCAFFOLD. Every value marked TODO_ is a placeholder and the shop must not go live until they are replaced with the owner's real details. The menu is still the template's dummy menu — see menu.json. Collect everything via docs/SHOP_INTAKE_FORM.md.

business._comment_shortName: Conversational short form used in page headers, aria labels and the staff PWA name (e.g. 'Pizza Bob's' instead of 'Pizza Bob's Burgers Ltd').
business._comment_sourced: address, postcode and hours were taken from public business listings, NOT from the owner. Confirm with the shop before launch. phone, email, legalName and companyNumber are still unknown.

_comment_theme: Brand colours. Defaults match Rico's red palette — change these to match the shop's branding.

delivery._comment_mode: Pick the delivery pricing model. 'outcode' = charge by postcode area (fill in allowedOutcodes + feeByOutcode below; this is Rico's model). 'radius' = charge by straight-line distance from the shop in bands (delete the outcode fields, add a radius block — see _comment_radius; this is Food Station's model). 'zones' = charge by hand-drawn map polygons, each with its own fee — use this when the shop already runs an irregular delivery map that rings and postcode areas cannot express; see _comment_zones. Distance and polygon lookups both geocode via postcodes.io (free, no key). See docs/ADDING_A_SHOP.md.
delivery._comment_areaDescription: Used in delivery messages: 'we deliver {areaDescription} only'. Keep natural so the sentence reads well.
delivery._comment_feePence: [outcode mode] Default delivery fee in pence, for any allowed outcode not given its own price in feeByOutcode.
delivery._comment_postcodes: [outcode mode] Outcodes (postcode prefixes) the shop delivers to. Must match the shop's own postcode area prefix (the letters before the digits).
delivery._comment_feeByOutcode: [outcode mode] Optional per-outcode delivery fee overrides in pence (key = postcode prefix). Outcodes not listed fall back to feePence. Leave empty to charge feePence everywhere.
delivery._comment_zones: [zones mode] Set mode to 'zones', drop the outcode fields, and add: "zones": [ { "name": "Town centre", "feePence": 0, "polygon": [[lat,lng],[lat,lng],...] }, ... ]. Each polygon is a list of [latitude, longitude] corners; it does not need to repeat its first point. ORDER MATTERS — the FIRST zone containing the customer wins, so list the cheapest/innermost first, which is also how you resolve zones that overlap. A postcode in no zone is refused with a nudge to collect. Draw the shapes at geojson.io and hand over the export. Minimum order is still the single minimumOrderPence above; per-zone minimums are not supported yet.
delivery._comment_radius: [radius mode] Set mode to 'radius', remove the three outcode fields above (keep minimumOrderPence + areaDescription), and add: "radius": { "maxMiles": 5, "bands": [ { "maxMiles": 1, "feePence": 100 }, { "maxMiles": 2, "feePence": 200 } ] }. Origin defaults to the shop's own postcode (override with radius.origin {lat,lng}). Bands checked low-to-high; beyond the largest maxMiles = no delivery.

_comment_serviceFee: Per-order platform fee in pence. Charged to the customer and kept by the platform.
_comment_stripe: Stripe Connect: this site's PaymentIntents are created on the venue's connected account. connectedAccountId is the venue's acct_xxx string from Stripe Connect.

hours._comment: 24-hour format. Closes after midnight are written as 25:00 = 01:00 next day. lastOrderBeforeCloseMinutes is subtracted automatically for the cut-off.

ordering._comment_businessDayStartHour: Trading-day rollover hour (0–23, shop local time). 4 = the day's orders / takings / Z-report run 4am-to-4am, so a late-night shop's orders taken after midnight still count toward the day it opened. Set 0 for a plain midnight-to-midnight day. Safe to leave at 4 even for daytime shops (if you close before midnight there's nothing in the 0–4am window to reclassify).

_comment_promo: Optional online discounts, both disabled by default — enable ONLY the one this shop actually runs. (1) autoOnlineDiscount: `percent`% off EVERY online order's subtotal, for everyone; shows in the cart, the SEO meta description and the terms page. (2) firstOrders: a signed-in customer gets `percent`% off their first `limit` orders — a welcome offer that rewards sign-ups. It's enforced server-side against the account (guests never qualify), only spends a redemption once the order is actually placed/paid, and takes precedence over autoOnlineDiscount (they don't stack). A matching banner shows on the landing page when it's on.
_comment_pos: Till behaviour flags (all optional, default off). requireOrderPin:true makes staff enter their operator code to START every order (walk-in/collection/delivery) — leave it false so staff take orders with no per-order PIN. NOTE: the manager/owner PIN on voids, refunds and cancellations is a SEPARATE gate and is ALWAYS required regardless of this flag. selfServeDrinks:true hides the till's drink picker; externalCardMachine:true marks the Card button as paid immediately for a shop using its own card terminal.

payments._comment_cvcThreshold: Order total (in pence) above which a customer paying with a saved card has to re-enter their CVV. Defends against account-takeover for higher-value orders. Set to 0 to never require CVC re-collection. £50 = 5000.

allergens.noticeAtCheckout: For allergens please contact the restaurant before ordering.

marketing._comment_metaPixelId: Meta (Facebook) Pixel ID from Events Manager (a numeric string). Set it to enable Facebook/Instagram ad conversion tracking: PageView on every customer page + Purchase on the thank-you page. Leave empty to keep the pixel off.

_comment_prelaunch: Keeps the shop out of Google until its real menu and prices are in. REMOVE both this and "prelaunch" on launch day.

seo._comment_description: The line Google shows under the result, written for a person. Leads with "Tad Kebab Tadcaster" because that adjacency is what a brand-name search matches on.
seo.description: Tad Kebab Tadcaster — stone baked pizzas and massive kebabs. Pizza, kebabs, burgers and more. Order online for collection or delivery in Tadcaster and surrounding areas.
seo._comment_ogImage: The picture shown when the link is shared on WhatsApp, Facebook or in a text — for a local takeaway that is most of how it travels. Cropped to 1200x630 from the hero photograph; regenerate if the hero changes. A logo letterboxes into the card and looks like nothing.
seo._comment_geo: MISSING and must not be guessed. Look up the shop's own postcode at https://api.postcodes.io/postcodes/LS24%208AA and paste lat/lng here. It feeds the Restaurant schema and the delivery service-area circle. This session could not fetch it — the egress policy blocks postcodes.io — and an invented coordinate puts the shop in the wrong place on Google.
seo._comment_sameAs: MISSING. The shop's own Instagram and Facebook URLs, which is how Google ties the site, the socials and the Google Business Profile together as one business. Ask the owner.
